targetTest: save leg: an unavailable tip is skipped with a log instead of refusing the whole save (WR-02)
expected: A catalog payload marks one custom tip unavailable and another healthy; a capture painting a built-in id saves successfully, carries exactly the healthy entry, and logs the skipped unavailable id.
actual: buildScriptBrushEntries refuses the whole save at the unavailable tip (its stored WebP is absent), so saveActiveFrame resolved false where true was expected (test line 960); no save request is written and the unavailable id costs every tip. The two WR-03 pins fail conversely — a capture painting wc/custom-* still saves successfully (true where false was expected, lines 978 and 1000).
